source_text:
9.36 Σύντριψον τὸν βραχίονα τοῦ ἁμαρ
τωλοῦ καὶ πονηροῦ. ̔Αμαρτωλός ἐστιν ὁ ἐξ ἡδυπαθείας καὶ ἀκολασίας ἁμαρτάνων·
πονηρὸς δὲ ὁ ἑκου σίως κακοποιητικός. –Βραχίονα δὲ ει πε τὴν πονηρὰ
κατεργασαμένην ψυχήν. ̔Η συν τριβὴ τοῦ βραχίονος ἀφανίζει τὰς ἁμαρτίας· τὸ δὲ
ἀπαλλαγῆναι τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν εὐεργε σία ἐστὶ τοῦ συντριβῆναί τινος βραχίονα· ου τω
καὶ ἐγὼ πείθομαι κολάζειν Θεῷ.
pass_a_gloss: Shatter the arm of-the sinner and wicked. Sinner is the from pleasure-loving and licentiousness sinning; wicked and the voluntarily evildoing. Arm and he-said the wickedness having-worked soul. The shattering of-the arm makes-vanish the sins; the and to-be-delivered of-the sins a-benefit is of-the to-be-shattered of-someone arm; thus also I am-persuaded to-punish to-God.
pass_b_english: “Shatter the arm of the sinner and the wicked” (Psalm 9:36).

A sinner is the one who sins from pleasure-loving and licentiousness; a wicked one is the one who is voluntarily an evildoer. And he said “arm” of the soul that has worked wickedness. The shattering of the arm makes the sins vanish; and to be delivered from sins is a benefit of someone’s arm being shattered; thus I also am persuaded that God punishes.

choices.why: Sinner from pleasure/licentiousness; wicked as voluntary evildoer. Not synonyms.
rejected: sinner and wicked as the same person-type
